title: Playback Media Maturity First Slices
problem: Nako's playback planner has source-aware facts and typed rendition output, but public client capability input and HLS/subtitle/HDR/audio constraints are still too shallow for Jellyfin-class self-hosted media pressure.

evidence.summary: Opened the first-slice playback media maturity refactor lane for richer public capability input, adaptive/fMP4 planning vocabulary, and subtitle/HDR/audio/constraint reasons.
Extended Public Client, browser ticket, renderer, OpenAPI, generated SDK, Rust client, and server query capability surfaces with richer direct-play limits and HLS planning preferences.
Added HLS single/adaptive and MPEG-TS/fMP4 planning vocabulary as transcode output requirements without changing executable HLS runtime behavior.
Used richer client capability limits to emit explicit bitrate, resolution, HDR, audio-channel, and selected-subtitle incompatibility reasons.
Verified focused Rust gates, regenerated SDK/Admin contracts, ran formatting and diff checks, and split executable adaptive HLS/fMP4 runtime work into follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: Closed on 2026-05-28. Continue with executable adaptive HLS ladders, fMP4/CMAF runtime output, DLNA device profiles, subtitle burn-in execution, or rsmpeg adapter work as separate lanes.
